question.text: The radius of fifth orbit of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>Li</mi><mrow><mo>+</mo><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> is<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>_______</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>12</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo>.</mo></math> Take: radius of hydrogen atom<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>51</mn><mo> </mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mo>∘</mo></mover></math>

solution.text:
The formula to calculate the radius of Lithium-ion is given by

RLi=RH×n2Z   ...(1)

Substitute the values of the known parameters into equation (1) to calculate the required radius of the ion.

RLi=0.51×253×10-10 m=425×10-12 m
